subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should `cron.defaults.delivery` be snapshotted into newly created jobs, or dynamically inherited by jobs with omitted fields whenever global configuration changes?
rationale: The inheritance model determines whether later configuration edits can silently redirect unattended output and affects storage, previews, editing, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Snapshot new jobs
options.body: Merge and validate defaults during creation, persist the route on the job, and keep existing recipients stable after configuration changes.

options.title: Dynamic inheritance
options.body: Resolve omitted fields from current global configuration on every run, enabling centralized retargeting but allowing silent recipient changes.

options.title: No inherited recipient
options.body: Keep recipients explicit per job and improve only CLI or Control UI creation defaults and safe `last` resolution.

recommendation.title: Snapshot new jobs
recommendation.body: Merge and validate defaults during creation, persist the route on the job, and keep existing recipients stable after configuration changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined signal from recent initial-default history and the prior focused product review of this issue.
